CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_app_role(requested_role app_role, requested_user uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.user_roles ur
    where ur.user_id = requested_user
      and ur.role = requested_role
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_property(property_uuid uuid, requested_user uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.can_manage_property(property_uuid, requested_user)
    or (
      public.is_tier1_verified(requested_user)
      and exists (
        select 1
        from public.listings l
        where l.property_id = property_uuid
          and l.status = 'active'
      )
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.tenancies t
      where t.property_id = property_uuid
        and requested_user in (t.tenant_id, t.landlord_id)
    );
$function$

functions.source:
select
        auth.uid() is not null
        and (
            -- Property owner
            exists (
                select 1
                from public.properties p
                where p.id = p_property_id
                  and p.landlord_id = auth.uid()
            )

            -- Admin
            or public.is_admin(auth.uid())

            -- Active tenancy participant
            or exists (
                select 1
                from public.tenancies t
                where t.property_id = p_property_id
                  and t.status = 'active'::public.tenancy_status
                  and (
                      t.tenant_id = auth.uid()
                      or t.landlord_id = auth.uid()
                  )
            )
        );

functions.args: p_latitude double precision, p_longitude double precision, p_radius_km integer, p_limit integer, p_offset integer
functions.name: search_nearby_listings
functions.source:
DECLARE
    v_tenant_location extensions.geography;
BEGIN
    IF p_latitude IS NULL
       OR p_latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90
       OR p_longitude IS NULL
       OR p_longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid GPS coordinates'
            USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;

    IF p_radius_km IS NULL
       OR p_radius_km NOT IN (1, 3, 5)
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Radius must be 1, 3, or 5 km'
            USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;

    IF p_limit IS NULL
       OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50
       OR p_offset IS NULL
       OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid pagination parameters'
            USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required'
            USING ERRCODE = '28000';
    END IF;

    IF NOT public.has_app_role(
        'tenant'::public.app_role, auth.uid()
    )
    OR NOT public.is_tier1_verified(auth.uid())
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant verification required'
            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

    v_tenant_location :=
        extensions.ST_SetSRID(
            extensions.ST_MakePoint(
                p_longitude,
                p_latitude
            ),
            4326
        )::extensions.geography;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        l.id,
        p.id,
        l.title,
        l.asking_rent_monthly,
        p.property_type::text,
        p.city::text,
        p.barangay,
        l.available_from,
        extensions.ST_Y(
            p.public_location::extensions.geometry
        ),
        extensions.ST_X(
            p.public_location::extensions.geometry
        ),
        ROUND(
            extensions.ST_Distance(
                p.public_location,
                v_tenant_location
            )::numeric, 2
        )
    FROM public.listings l
    JOIN public.properties p
        ON p.id = l.property_id
    WHERE l.status = 'active'::public.listing_status
      AND p.is_active IS TRUE
      AND (
          l.available_from IS NULL
          OR l.available_from <=
              (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date
      )
      AND extensions.ST_DWithin(
          p.public_location,
          v_tenant_location,
          p_radius_km * 1000.0
      )
    ORDER BY
        extensions.ST_Distance(
            p.public_location,
            v_tenant_location
        ),
        l.id
    LIMIT p_limit
    OFFSET p_offset;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_nearby_listings(p_latitude double precision, p_longitude double precision, p_radius_km integer DEFAULT 3, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_tenant_location extensions.geography;
BEGIN
    IF p_latitude IS NULL
       OR p_latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90
       OR p_longitude IS NULL
       OR p_longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid GPS coordinates'
            USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;

    IF p_radius_km IS NULL

            USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;

    IF p_limit IS NULL
       OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50

       OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid pagination parameters'
            USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required'
            USING ERRCODE = '28000';
    END IF;

    IF NOT public.has_app_role(
        'tenant'::public.app_role, auth.uid()
    )
    OR NOT public.is_tier1_verified(auth.uid())
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant verification required'
            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

    v_tenant_location :=
        extensions.ST_SetSRID(
            extensions.ST_MakePoint(
                p_longitude,
                p_latitude
            ),
            4326
        )::extensions.geography;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        l.id,
        p.id,
        l.title,
        l.asking_rent_monthly,
        p.property_type::text,
        p.city::text,
        p.barangay,
        l.available_from,
        extensions.ST_Y(
            p.public_location::extensions.geometry
        ),
        extensions.ST_X(
            p.public_location::extensions.geometry
        ),
        ROUND(
            extensions.ST_Distance(
                p.public_location,
                v_tenant_location
            )::numeric, 2
        )
    FROM public.listings l
    JOIN public.properties p
        ON p.id = l.property_id
    WHERE l.status = 'active'::public.listing_status
      AND p.is_active IS TRUE
      AND (
          l.available_from IS NULL
          OR l.available_from <=
              (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date
      )
      AND extensions.ST_DWithin(
          p.public_location,
          v_tenant_location,
          p_radius_km * 1000.0
      )
    ORDER BY
        extensions.ST_Distance(
            p.public_location,
            v_tenant_location
        ),
        l.id
    LIMIT p_limit
    OFFSET p_offset;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rentlease_property_edit.lock_owner(p_property_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' then raise exception 'READ COMMITTED required' using errcode='25001';end if;
 if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_tier1_verified(auth.uid()) or not public.has_app_role('landlord'::public.app_role,auth.uid()) then
 raise exception 'Tier 1 active landlord required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_property_id::text,0));
 if not exists(select 1 from public.properties where id=p_property_id and landlord_id=auth.uid() and is_active) then
 raise exception 'Owned active property required' using errcode='42501';end if;
end$function$
